metadata.description: P4: two plugins. p4-temportal keeps Claude Code's memory, notebook and temp files in the repo with lifetimes; p4-phi hands linked sessions their context and recalls the repo's own history next to each message. Each keeps its files in its own directory under .claude/p4/; the design is .docs/p4/fresh-marketplace.md and .docs/p4/recall-node.md.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Keeps every file Claude Code would otherwise write under AppData or the system temp directory in <project>/.claude/p4/temportal/: the memory, the notebook, each session's scratchpad and saved code. Files get lifetimes like a browser's cache and cookies, and what has expired is cleared. Replaces p4-memory and p4-scratchpad.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked sessions hand each other, and recall from the repo's own history, in one plugin. Every session starts with the store's rules; a started session is given the tasks and notes of the sessions above it, ordered by its own task, and the last turn of the sessions beside it; every finished turn's report reaches the session that started it in full; a message about something else gets a forked session. Recall, the p4-recall plugin until 0.7.0, adds a few lines from the store beside a message or a subagent's task when its ranker is confident, and nothing otherwise. Kept in <project>/.claude/p4/phi/.
